title: A faithful servant of God
belief: I am a faithful servant of God, living in submission to Him. I meet both favorable outcomes and disappointments with trust, humility, and acceptance. I offer my work and its fruits to Him. I remember Him throughout my day and recognize His presence in all things as they unfold.

title: A creator of wealth through service
belief: I am capable of creating substantial wealth by helping people live out their deepest, most constructive desires. I create opportunities, experiences, and tools that help them grow into who they want to be. I receive the rewards of that contribution with confidence and gratitude, and use my wealth responsibly and generously.

title: A responsible and loving son
belief: I am a dependable source of love, protection, and support for my mother. I make sure her needs are met and stay present in her life so she feels cared for and connected. Through my words and actions, she knows she can rely on me. She rests peacefully, knowing she is loved and that I am there for her.

title: A loving and dependable husband
belief: I am a loving, patient, and dependable husband. I speak to my wife with kindness and treat her feelings with care. I provide steady emotional and practical support, creating a home where she feels safe, loved, and free to be herself. She can express her femininity, speak honestly, and accept herself without fear of judgment. We face uncertainty together, and my consistent presence helps her feel secure in the life we are building.
